title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — September 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.7 (Peaked September 20, 2026 at 22:34 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 356 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

A little solar flare! 🔥🚀

A broad coronal-hole region stands out across the Sun’s southern-central disk in today’s ultraviolet views.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
